items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I think it was [Frascedelli's] (inaudible). Favorite Note.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think it was [Frascedelli's] (inaudible). Favorite Note.

MR. SIMMONS: It was close to Sixth Avenue. And all of a sudden it started raining, so we ran across the street to the bar and I stayed there. That's Billie's hangout, the bar. I get outside and I whistle for a cab and a cab would stop and before I could open the door some white man would open the door on the other side and jump in. Naturally the cab driver would take him.
